svg.title: From QPSK indices to a shaped waveform

cc:Work.dc:title: From QPSK indices to a shaped waveform
cc:Work.dc:description: The numbered QPSK points scale a two-symbol Gaussian pulse. The bottom plot sums the overlapping pulses into I and Q time series.
